name: How much does pool removal add to resale value in Southern California?

mainEntity.name: Does removing a pool help or hurt home value in neighborhoods like Glendale, Pasadena, or Los Angeles?
mainEntity.text: Does removing a pool help or hurt home value in neighborhoods like Glendale, Pasadena, or Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: Pool removal does not affect every home the same way. In some Los Angeles-area neighborhoods, a larger usable yard can make a property more appealing because buyers want lower maintenance, more play space, or room for outdoor living. In other areas, especially where pools are common and expected, removing one may narrow the buyer pool. The best value outcome depends on the home’s size, the lot’s layout, and the local market. If the yard will be transformed into an attractive, functional outdoor space, the removal can be a strong selling point. If the site is left unfinished or poorly graded, it may feel like a downgrade. Homeowners considering resale should think beyond demolition and plan the post-removal yard design at the same time. That gives the property a clear purpose once the pool is gone.
acceptedAnswer.description: Pool removal can help resale value for buyers who want more yard space, lower maintenance, and fewer safety concerns, but it can also reduce value where pools are expected. The effect depends on the neighborhood, lot size, and buyer preferences.
